channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tom Gores | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tom Gores from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Trajan Langdon, Tom Gores
item.description:
“For us as coaches, we are trying to figure out, 'What is my job? What are the expectations? And how do I continue to move those expectations forward?' The best organization in this league is the team that is the most consistent. When things get rocky, they hunker down on the things they believe in, the people they believe in and the players they believe in. ... I am truly blessed to be where I am with Trajan Langdon and Tom Gores. They are the type of people who, when things get tough, have my back and have shown that.”

JB Bickerstaff on Trajan Langdon, Tom Gores, Jun 4, 2025. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Monty Williams on Tom Gores
item.description:
Williams on meeting with Gores:

“I feel like he was showing his support and how invested he is.“What I saw was someone who didn’t want us to think he’s not in the fight with us. Saw a competitive edge. He’s not happy about this.”

Monty Williams on Tom Gores, Dec 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Isaiah Stewart on Tom Gores
item.description:
Isaiah Stewart told The Athletic via telephone on Tuesday.

“I told him my next goal is to outplay this contract and continue to prove him right. Troy is someone who believes in me and my game, what I can become. My goal has always been to prove him right. I want to prove myself right, too. I put in a lot of work. “It makes me feel very grateful. They’re rewarding me for the work that I’ve done and what I can become. I’m very appreciative to the front office, (owner) Tom Gores, Troy.”

Isaiah Stewart on Tom Gores, Jul 12, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Monty Williams on Tom Gores
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Williams:

“Mr. Gores, your generosity has changed my life at the right time and been a huge blessing to my family. We had a lot of things going on, and the patience that you all extended to us has made the difference.”

Monty Williams on Tom Gores, Jun 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Tom Gores
item.description:
Keith Langlois:Casey:

“I'm excited for what we've done, the culture and foundation that we've built. It's been a good 44 years. Tom (Gores) has given me the opportunity to move into the front office and I'm excited about it, to go to the next phase of my life.”

Dwane Casey on Tom Gores, Apr 10, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: DJ Bakker on Troy Weaver, Arn Tellem, Tom Gores
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dj Bakker on the opportunity to coach the Cruise:

“Very thankful to our ownership group of Tom Gores, Arn Tellem; and Troy Weaver and Rob (Murphy).”

DJ Bakker on Troy Weaver, Arn Tellem, Tom Gores, Aug 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Tom Gores, Andre Drummond
item.description:
Dwane Casey on the Andre Drummond trade:

“It was as much of a business decision as anything else. The direction we were going in, the direction he needed to go in from an individual standpoint. I know Tom (Gores) loved Andre, our whole organization loved Andre.”

Dwane Casey on Tom Gores, Andre Drummond, Dec 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Ed Stefanski on Tom Gores
item.description:
#PistonsEd Stefanski on front office structure:

“I see myself as the senior adviser to Tom Gores... I'm all about winning. We all have egos.”

Ed Stefanski on Tom Gores, Jun 22, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Tom Gores
item.description:
#Pistons GMTroy Weaver:

“When I met Tom (Gores) on Zoom. I was blown away... what he has in his heart for the Pistons and who he is and what he stands for, I was sold in the first two minutes.”

Troy Weaver on Tom Gores, Jun 22, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Andre Drummond on Tom Gores
item.description:
Vincent Ellis:Andre Drummond on new facility:

“I've been to the USA (Basketball) facility and I think this tops it by a lot. I think Tom Gores and the people that had their hands on this facility did an excellent job of giving us a state-of-the-art facility.”

Andre Drummond on Tom Gores, Oct 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @Vincent_Ellis56.

item.title: Andre Drummond on Tom Gores, Blake Griffin
item.description:
#Pistons Andre Drummond on Blake Griffin trade:

“(Tom Gores) gave me an idea (before the deal) and said they were looking to trade for him but they didn’t know who they were going to give up for him ...I said, ‘Oh, (crap) — if they’re going to give him up, let’s take him.’”

Andre Drummond on Tom Gores, Blake Griffin, Oct 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Tom Gores
item.description:
#Pistons Casey on Gores:

“The relationship he has with the players is real. I’ve talked to every player and the first thing they talked about is how they want to play for the Pistons.”

Dwane Casey on Tom Gores, Jun 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Tom Gores
item.description:
“I had a great meeting the other night with Tom Gores at his home in L.A. A great guy, a very dynamic owner, very impressed with him and his leadership, his vision.”

Dwane Casey on Tom Gores, Jun 10, 2018. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Ed Stefanski on Tom Gores
item.description:
“And then I am going to give advice to our owner Tom Gores on how we are going to structure things going forward. The big thing right now, though, is that we need a head coach and a GM. Those will be two items that we will probably do simultaneously.”

Ed Stefanski on Tom Gores, May 24, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Andre Drummond on Tom Gores
item.description:
#PistonsAndre Drummond:

“Without Gores, this wouldn't be possible ... (thanks) my mom and my little sister.”

Andre Drummond on Tom Gores, Jul 15, 2016. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Arn Tellem on Tom Gores
item.description:
“But in another sense it was an easy decision, because I am joining another great organization with an outstanding leader in Tom Gores, who is committed to ensuring Palace Sports & Entertainment is a championship organization both on the court and in the community.”

Arn Tellem on Tom Gores, Jun 5, 2015. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Tom Gores
item.description:
“I’ve had the pleasure of working with some great people throughout the last 29 years as both a player and executive, and I’m proud of our accomplishments. Tom Gores and ownership is committed to winning and they will continue to move the franchise forward.”

Joe Dumars on Tom Gores, Apr 14, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Tom Izzo on Tom Gores
item.description:
“I think it’s some guy sitting behind a computer that is one of my favorite human beings on the planet, which are those social media geeks which are sitting at a computer and just making up stories, and everybody says, ‘Well, you know their owner and he’s a Michigan State guy. ...’ “I’ve never met Tom Gores, I’ve never talked to Tom Gores. I think somebody, maybe it’s Michigan fans are putting that out.”

Tom Izzo on Tom Gores, Mar 27, 2014. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Karen Davidson on Tom Gores
item.description:
“We are pleased to welcome Tom Gores as the new owner of the Detroit Pistons and Palace Sports and Entertainment,”

Karen Davidson on Tom Gores, Apr 8, 2011. Source: Booth Newspapers.
